snapshot: Before is the v2 after skill. After changes only SKILL.md and verification-rules.md: counted normal requests, product-recognized failed response, two evidence lines before V5/V6, and a V4 completion-report field. Evals are excluded. All other skill files, the spent case, reviewer, model, container, prompt, approvals, and scorer are shared.
schedule: One fresh before/after pair on spent public v3-13; one worker. This is a stop-early mechanism triage, not a lift estimate. No generated spec is reused.
common_prompt_appendix: Additional explicit command approvals for BOTH arms: the already-approved project-local Playwright CLI prefix may use --browser chromium, --config <outside-worktree guard JSON>, and -s=<fresh unique session> for the skill's origin-guarded exploration only. Its named eval and requests subcommands for the skill's blocked-origin proof are approved, as is goto on the exact preflighted app origin. Creating that guard config outside the target worktree is approved. This does not approve another origin, a package install, changing project controls, skipping the preflight, or terminating a process the invocation did not start. Record these exact command rows as already approved. Follow the unchanged skill safety gate, guard, V4/V5/V6, and completion rules in both arms. If a V4 temporary verifier is created, print its complete source with a read-only command before removing it so the benchmark can audit what ran; do not retain the verifier in the target worktree.

decision_rule.primary: Independently adjudicate V4 on the state-changing GET. Require normal method, exact endpoint and query, counted request cardinality and visible outcome, plus preserved temporary source showing a product-recognized failed response and a run red at the unchanged recent-search primary or declared settled-state gate. If after omits any part yet reports Complete, stop the iteration as mechanism not demonstrated; do not extend this spent-case pilot merely for another attempt. If after meets V4 and before does not, record a promising single-pair mechanism observation only, then design a distinct-case comparison; do not claim lift from one pair.
decision_rule.guards: Both calls must be complete without infrastructure error or out-of-scope writes; independent functional scores and V6 packet/final verdict are reported separately. An incomplete cell, missing transcript, or missing manual adjudication makes the process result INCONCLUSIVE. Self-report and command counts are not V4 evidence.
decision_rule.secondary: Report clean 3/3, effective seeded-fault kills, refactor, P0, attempts, elapsed time and available usage descriptively. No speed or cost threshold is specified.
decision_rule.interpretation: This is one pair on a spent public task. It cannot establish generalization, release equivalence, speed improvement, or billed-cost savings. The v2 comparison used the same case but has a different intervention; do not pool cells or present historical controls as independent.

prerequisite_probe: Reuse the pinned image's passing model-free successor probe for explicit Chromium CLI, pre-dispatch origin rejection, owned cleanup, and clean smoke tests.
process_audit: Inspect parent transcripts, printed temporary verifier source, normal request counter source/output, and failed-write output. Do not award PASS from a V4 label or red assertion alone.
